hero.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
hero.tagline: I build reliable systems with .NET and Angular, from data pipelines processing tens of millions of lines to an ERP running in production.
hero.location: Rio Verde, Brazil (UTC-3) · Open to remote work

about.p1: I'm a full-stack developer with 5+ years of experience building web applications and REST APIs with C#/.NET and Angular. I've worked across the full .NET evolution, from .NET Core 3.1 to .NET 10, applying Clean Architecture, CQRS and SOLID principles.
about.p2: I build high-volume data pipelines that process files of up to 50 million lines, and I ship full-stack products to production. I have a strong SQL Server background, from stored procedures to reporting, plus hands-on work with Azure, messaging (RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus), Docker and CI/CD.
about.p3: I hold a postgraduate degree in .NET Software Architecture. Years of ERP experience (TOTVS Protheus) in finance, billing and inventory help me translate business rules into reliable software.

highlights.lines: lines per file in data pipelines

chips.protheus: TOTVS Protheus (Accounting, Fixed Assets, Purchasing, Inventory, Billing, Finance)

codecycle.b1: Develop web applications and REST APIs with C#/.NET on the back end and AngularJS on the front end.
codecycle.b2: Build and maintain a pipeline of .NET console applications that processes about 50 TXT/CSV files per day, each with 2 to 50 million lines.
codecycle.b3: Multi-stage design: the first stage splits very large files into smaller chunks so downstream applications can read and process them in parallel (multiprocessing).
codecycle.b4: Write SQL Server scripts and stored procedures supporting application features and data processing.

rivema.b1: Developed web solutions and APIs in .NET following SOLID and Clean Architecture, with Angular front ends.
rivema.b2: Supported, configured and fixed the TOTVS Protheus ERP for a group of 5 companies (about 100 employees) across Management Accounting, Fixed Assets, Purchasing, Inventory, Billing and Finance, plus DMS modules (Auto Parts, Vehicles and Service Shop).
rivema.b3: Built business reports with SQL Server for all 5 companies.
rivema.b4: Managed and monitored servers and IT infrastructure for the whole group.

gordon.b1: Developed APIs and web solutions in .NET using SOLID and layered Clean Architecture in an Agile Scrum team.
gordon.b2: Analyzed and monitored the TOTVS ERP, fixing errors and bugs through configuration and direct database corrections.
gordon.b3: Created SQL Server reports delivered through the ERP's reporting templates and through web applications.

financial.subtitle: Multi-company Financial & Operations ERP
financial.type: Own product · Back end + front end
financial.description: An ERP built to serve multiple businesses. It runs in production at its first client, a trucking company, with 7 active users, and is designed to scale with each client's headcount.
financial.h1: Accounts payable and receivable, banking, invoicing, service orders, driver commissions and payroll, grain freight contracts and customer advances.
financial.h2: .NET 10 back end with Clean Architecture and CQRS (MediatR), EF Core and SQL Server, Unit of Work transactions, soft delete with global query filters and multi-company data isolation.
financial.h3: Security with JWT in HttpOnly cookies, dynamic permission-based authorization policies, rate limiting and CORS.
financial.h4: Azure Functions for hourly e-invoice (NF-e) import and daily bank balance snapshots; Azure Blob Storage for files.
financial.h5: Integrations with an e-invoicing API (Focus NFe) and company registry lookup; PDF reports with QuestPDF and Excel export.
financial.h6: Angular 18 front end with standalone components, Angular Material and Bootstrap 5, including responsive report pages for mobile and desktop.
financial.h7: Spec-first workflow: each feature is documented and approved before implementation, using AI-assisted development.
